# Resonance Lab: authorship and component notices

The original assembly arrangement, authored model files, programs,
generators, analysis, lessons, validation source, measured data and original
numerical plots are Copyright (c) 2026 **Christian Ströbele (CrispStrobe)**,
distributed under the **BSD-3-Clause** license in `LICENSE`. Generic

credited author.

## Referenced standard parts

The LDR and MPD reference standard LDraw parts and primitives. Their geometry
is an external dependency and retains each file's own author and license
notices. No standard part geometry is embedded in the BSD source archive.

The separate CAD previews include the complete notices for the actual
recursively resolved meshes. Those illustrations are distributed with their
own attribution and license record. That record does not relicense either
the external parts library or the original source package.

The plots in `validation/` contain original mathematical curves and measured
numerical observations, with no standard-part mesh. They are part of the
original BSD work.

## External execution environment

Brickwright's importer, part metadata, registering compiler, Scratch VM
overlay, hub controller and native Jolt runtime remain in separate pinned
application and dependency directories. The included package manifest and
lockfile identify exact dependencies and integrity values. Their source and
executables are not redistributed inside this add-on. Preserve their
respective notices when acquiring or distributing them separately.

The model uses the existing native tension-only rubber-band law, estimated
part masses, default body angular damping and ordinary inferred hinges.
No physical coefficient or engine implementation was changed for this model.
Its evidence describes the pinned simulator. Physical rubber-band stiffness,
hysteresis, bearing friction and the resulting resonant frequency still need
measurement on hardware.

## Originality boundary

No third-party mechanism CAD, image, prose or program was copied from
dmg-lib.org or another mechanism site. The layout, placement ledger and
equations were authored for this add-on. No noncommercial or unlicensed
asset is included.

LEGO, Technic and SPIKE names identify compatible parts and hardware. This
is an independent educational add-on; those names imply no endorsement.
